ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approx. 90% of the visible surface area, with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters primarily on the distal tips and peripheral trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous banding along the peripheral trailing edges of both lobes; distinct high-contrast 'figure-eight' shaped white cluster in the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe; multiple small white focal spots scattered across the dark central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees relative to the lobe axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (irregular peaks and valleys) visible along the entire superior trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a slight convex curvature towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible circular high-contrast pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring, heavily concentrated on the distal outer edges of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (light gray scratches/rake marks) distributed across the dark pigment of both lobes, varying in length and orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) on lobe tips and numerous linear rake marks across the central fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique '8-shaped' or double-circle white pigmentation mark located on the lower-inner portion of the left fluke lobe.
